transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Lee. To start off, what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Lee. Well, I'm here because lately I just can't seem to keep my head clear at work. I'll be in a session and completely lose track of what my clients are saying. Or I'll sit there and reread the same chart note over and over again because it just doesn't sink in. It's like my brain just stalls, and I end up freezing on really simple decisions that I used to handle without any problem. It's just getting really hard to do my job.
How long have you been noticing this trouble focusing and freezing on decisions—days, weeks, or longer?

It's been... I'd say about a month now. Yeah, roughly a month. It started right around the time the clinic lost some staff. Because of that, my schedule got shifted into late-evening coverage, and I've had to take on a lot heavier crisis paperwork since then.
Since your schedule shifted to evening hours, how has your sleep been—are you getting enough, and does it feel restful?

My sleep hasn't been great, honestly. I'll get home from work and I'm really tired, but then I just lie there in bed for hours... usually just replaying the day in my head. And if I do finally manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way before my alarm goes off. When I do get up, it feels like I barely slept at all, so no, it definitely doesn't feel restful.
Over this past month, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I guess I have. I just... I don't really have the energy or desire to do much of anything lately. My guitar has just been sitting in the corner gathering dust. I keep bailing on my weekend soccer games and my shifts at the animal shelter. Even when I try to force myself to do things I usually like, like cooking a nice meal or going for a hike, it just feels like I'm going through the motions. There's just no point to it, you know? It doesn't bring me any joy anymore.
Have you noticed yourself worrying excessively about a number of different things—like work, health, or other areas of your life—and finding it hard to control that worry, even when you try?

Not really, no. I mean, I wouldn't say I'm worrying about a bunch of different things or anything like that. It's more just... I'm too tired to care about much right now. I don't have that feeling of being anxious or not being able to control my worries, just the lack of energy and interest.
Over this past month, have you found yourself feeling unusually worthless, or excessively guilty about things, even minor ones?

Yeah, I have. It's actually been happening a lot at work. If I miss just one detail in a note, or... or if I forget to return a call right away, I just really beat myself up over it. I keep telling myself that I'm useless. It just feels like I'm letting the clients down, and really everyone else at the clinic, too. I know they're just small mistakes, but the guilt over it feels really heavy lately.
Have you had any thoughts of death or of hurting yourself during this past month?

I don't have a plan to actually hurt myself, no. But... I do keep having these thoughts lately. Just thinking that it would be a lot easier if I went to sleep and didn't wake up. It scares me a bit, honestly, because I know what that can mean.
Over this past month, have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight, either an increase or a decrease?

Yeah, my appetite has definitely gone down. Most days I just don't feel hungry until someone actually reminds me to eat. I've been skipping meals without really meaning to, just because it doesn't cross my mind or I don't have the energy for it. I've definitely lost some weight, too... I've noticed my pants have gotten pretty loose lately.
Have you ever had a period, lasting several days or more, where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than usual, along with being more talkative or impulsive than normal?
No, I haven't ever felt like that. I've pretty much just been feeling down and drained lately. I've never had a time where I felt super energetic or didn't need to sleep.
